topic_thesis: That '12% high-dividend' stock isn't passive income—it's a mathematical trap hiding massive capital destruction.
strategic_angle: Exposing the Dividend Yield illusion: Yield skyrockets not because companies are generous, but because their stock price has crashed by 40-50%. Retail investors blindly chase the fake '8-12% yield', only to get hit twice—first by severe capital loss, and second when struggling management inevitably slashes the dividend to preserve cash.
key_statistic: 19% of Indian firms slashed dividends after stock crashes wiped out 35%+ retail capital
target_emotion: Sudden realization and panic to audit personal stock portfolio
pinned_comment_text: Are you holding 'high-dividend' PSU or commodity stocks for passive income? Check your Net P&L (Capital Loss minus Dividend received). Comment 'TRAP' and we'll DM you our Dividend Yield Safety Audit Checklist! 📉👇
